name: Dragonborn
description: Descended from dragons and carrying the proof in their scales and their breath. Dragonborn are built broad and proud, and a draconic ancestry decides both the damage they exhale and the damage they shrug off.

traits.name: Draconic Ancestry
traits.description: Choose a dragon type when the character is made. That choice fixes the damage type and the area of your Breath Weapon, and the damage you resist.

traits.name: Breath Weapon
traits.description: Exhale destructive energy as an action, in the shape and damage type your ancestry sets. Each creature in the area makes a saving throw against DC 8 + your Constitution modifier + your proficiency bonus, taking 2d6 damage on a failure and half as much on a success. The damage rises to 3d6 at 6th level, 4d6 at 11th and 5d6 at 16th. Once per short or long rest.

traits.name: Damage Resistance
traits.description: You have resistance to the damage type of your draconic ancestry.
